_doc: Pessoas no 4.0, 16:00: censo do que fazem e fotos de perto.

steps.eval: (() => { const r = window.__roadcraft, s = r.sim; const out = { keys: Object.keys(s).slice(0, 60) }; const views = s.pedViews ?? (s.world && s.world.pedViews) ?? []; const list = [...(views.values ? views.values() : views)]; out.n = list.length; const count = (f) => { const c = {}; for (const p of list) { const k = f(p); c[k] = (c[k] ?? 0) + 1; } return c; }; out.gesture = count((p) => p.gesture ? p.gesture.kind + ':' + p.gesture.phase : '-'); out.party = count((p) => p.party ? p.party.archetype + p.party.size : '-'); out.age = count((p) => p.ageClass + p.gender); out.ground = count((p) => p.ground); out.carry = count((p) => (p.carry ?? '') + (p.hand ?? '') + (p.style ?? '')); window.__peds = list; return JSON.stringify(out); })()

(() => { const r = window.__roadcraft, L = window.__peds; const p = (L.find((p) => p.gesture && p.gesture.kind === 'bench')); if (!p) return 'nenhum pessoa-banco'; r.setView({ x: p.x, y: p.y, zoom: 14, azimuth: p.heading + 2.4, elevation: 18 * Math.PI / 180 }); return 'pessoa-banco ' + p.id; })()

(() => { const r = window.__roadcraft, L = window.__peds; const p = (L.find((p) => p.gesture && p.gesture.kind === 'phone')); if (!p) return 'nenhum pessoa-fone'; r.setView({ x: p.x, y: p.y, zoom: 14, azimuth: p.heading + 2.4, elevation: 18 * Math.PI / 180 }); return 'pessoa-fone ' + p.id; })()

(() => { const r = window.__roadcraft, L = window.__peds; const p = (L.find((p) => p.party && p.party.size > 2 && p.walking)); if (!p) return 'nenhum pessoa-grupo'; r.setView({ x: p.x, y: p.y, zoom: 14, azimuth: p.heading + 2.4, elevation: 18 * Math.PI / 180 }); return 'pessoa-grupo ' + p.id; })()

(() => { const r = window.__roadcraft, L = window.__peds; const p = (L.find((p) => p.ageClass === 'child' && p.walking)); if (!p) return 'nenhum pessoa-crianca'; r.setView({ x: p.x, y: p.y, zoom: 14, azimuth: p.heading + 2.4, elevation: 18 * Math.PI / 180 }); return 'pessoa-crianca ' + p.id; })()

(() => { const r = window.__roadcraft, L = window.__peds; const p = (L.find((p) => p.kerbWait > 0)); if (!p) return 'nenhum pessoa-espera'; r.setView({ x: p.x, y: p.y, zoom: 14, azimuth: p.heading + 2.4, elevation: 18 * Math.PI / 180 }); return 'pessoa-espera ' + p.id; })()

(() => { const r = window.__roadcraft, L = window.__peds; const p = (L.find((p) => p.walking && p.ground === 'footway')); if (!p) return 'nenhum pessoa-rua'; r.setView({ x: p.x, y: p.y, zoom: 40, azimuth: p.heading + 2.4, elevation: 12 * Math.PI / 180 }); return 'pessoa-rua ' + p.id; })()
